title: approvalInbox
responsibility: Defines the shared native deployment decision, Go, runner admission and provider progress schemas.

outputs.name: deployApprovalPath
outputs.description: Fixed Hub path used by the native account and trusted runner.

outputs.name: approvalWindowMs
outputs.description: Maximum lifetime in milliseconds for one registered approval or Go request.

outputs.name: approvalClockSkewMs
outputs.description: Clock skew allowance in milliseconds between runner and Hub.

outputs.name: approvalScope
outputs.description: Exact registered project and deployment environment.

outputs.name: approvalCard
outputs.description: Bounded metadata for an exact immutable plan, preview, rollback or signed review.

outputs.name: approvalReceipt
outputs.description: One native allow or deny receipt bound to an actor and plan digest.

outputs.name: approvalDecision
outputs.description: Native intent to allow, deny, or record Go for the specified attempt and plan.

outputs.name: goReceipt
outputs.description: Confirmed Go timestamp bound to the requested attempt and plan.

outputs.name: deployProgress
outputs.description: Filtered provider operation, route verification, cleanup or sign-off progress.

outputs.name: approvalCards
outputs.description: Native card list with decision, Go and safe runner progress when available.

outputs.name: runnerInput
outputs.description: Scoped commands for card registration, approval collection, execution admission and reporting.
